notes.text: One of three Colombian Supremo pourover batches (#42, #43, #44) roasted as birthday gifts for family, for drip brewers. Charged before the app said ready: ET was 181.4 and still rising 1.1 °C/min (ready charges had 184-185.5, flat), so the roast ran about 1:20 behind #40 (FC 7:35 at 185.6, vs 7:00 at 188.4). Second crack seemed to be starting, so the door was opened at 203.8, just under the 204.3 drop. A bit darker than #43 and #44.
